issues.description: Removed category badge config breaks active filter badge display for findings
issues.detail: The deletion of the `category__in` entry from DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES means the new Category filter on the findings page will no longer render a labeled active-filter badge when applied. The PR adds the filter but removes its badge config without a replacement, causing a UX regression where users won't see the active category filter as a removable chip.

issues.description: labelFormatter applied to badgeLabel may break filter selection/identity logic
issues.detail: In data-table-filter-custom.tsx, `getBadgeLabel(entity, displayLabel)` is now passed the human-readable label instead of the raw value. If `getBadgeLabel` or downstream code uses this string as an identifier (e.g., for selection state, removal, or query param construction), passing the formatted label like "IAM" instead of "iam" could break filter round-tripping.

issues.description: Short-word heuristic mislabels common category words
issues.detail: The `word.length <= 3` rule in getCategoryLabel uppercases any short word. Categories like "new", "old", "web", "app", or future additions would render as "NEW", "WEB", etc. Since the old explicit dictionary was removed, any new backend category that happens to be short and not an acronym will display incorrectly without anyone noticing.

issues.description: Duplicate SEVERITY_ORDER value for Informational/Info may cause ordering ambiguity
issues.detail: Adding `Info: 4` alongside `Informational: 4` gives two keys the same rank. If consumer code iterates entries or uses the object for reverse lookup (rank -> label), behavior becomes non-deterministic. Safer to normalize input to a single canonical key upstream rather than duplicating the rank.

issues.description: Duplicate filter index 5 may cause unstable filter ordering
issues.detail: The new Category filter is assigned `index: 5`, but other existing filters in findings-filters.tsx likely already use index 5 or nearby values. Without checking the full filter list, duplicate indices can lead to non-deterministic ordering in the FilterControls UI.

issues.description: CategorySelector handleValueChange handles unreachable empty string case
issues.detail: The Select component from shadcn cannot emit an empty string value (it rejects empty SelectItem values), so the `value === ""` branch is dead code. Minor cleanup: just check for "all".

review.summary: The PR cleanly extracts category label logic to a shared module and adds a useful Risk Radar filtering UX. However, removing the `category__in` entry from DEFAULT_FILTER_BADGES while simultaneously adding a category filter to findings looks like an unintended regression for the active-filter badge UI. The new generic getCategoryLabel heuristic is more brittle than the explicit mapping it replaced — short non-acronym words will be uppercased — and the labelFormatter change in DataTableFilterCustom risks confusing raw values with display labels in downstream identity logic. The duplicate Info/Informational severity rank and rebranding to \"Prowler ThreatScore\" are otherwise low-risk but worth a second look for consistency.
